plan_name: Experiment Round 2 (exp01) config B replicate 1 — wider K2 exploration. Identical to the Round 1 baseline replicates (same bank, fixture, shape, trained_spokes, judge, conditions) except plan_id/plan_name. REQUIRES config.yaml state: hyperparameters.retrieval_level2_top_k: 2 (baseline 1) AND reporting.pass_rank_thresholds.spoke_retrieval: 5 (baseline 4 — a spoke gold reached via K2 now occupies rank 4 or 5; config.yaml's own threshold comment mandates adjusting with K1/K2), all else baseline — RunPlan cannot express hyperparameters, so the config lives in config.yaml per the M42 protocol (BUILD-PLAN.md); analytics.full_config_snapshot is the provenance record. MEASUREMENT NOTE: pass-rate LEVELS under this config are not comparable to baseline or cfgA (different retrieved-set geometry and threshold) — only within-run learned-vs-static comparisons and per-cluster winner/alignment tables are cross-config comparable. random_seed 20260809 reuses Round 1 rep2's seed (quasi-paired comparison). Question under test: does surfacing two spokes per K2 traversal instead of one get the trained spoke retrieved (and credited) early enough to beat rich-get-richer lock-in on a lucky neighbor.
